source.description:
OPERATOR DIRECTION (2026-08-14 robot identities dispatch; Jira ISSUE-87 portfolio surface only). Slice 1 (xtrm-c4z, PR #99) landed generic contracts: xtrm.principal-set.v1, xtrm.actor.v1, xtrm.execution-identity.v1, xtrm.provenance.v1 + trusted-context assembly, validation, GitHub/Jira projections, legacy attribution semantics, documented-not-executed cutover. Do NOT redesign Slice 1.

SLICE 2 SCOPE (wire one real trusted lane into the landed contracts + prove one bounded end-to-end mutation canary, NO account/connector cutover):
A. Trusted context source: use the existing chain-runtime scheduler lane (experiments/agentsession-sre-chain-vertical-slice/src/chain/scheduler.ts makeIdentity + ResolvedChain + StepExecutionState) as the trusted host/local execution lane. Add an adapter that populates ResolvedExecutionContext: actor, principal_set, execution identity, assignment/version, authority, participant/parent lineage, runtime session. Reject missing actor/assignment/execution/authority. Use a registered principal set. NEVER take identity fields from model/prompt-controlled payloads.
B. No duplicate identity system: reuse existing participant_id/job_id/execution_id/runtime_session_id/assignment/authority semantics from the chain runtime + Slice 1 contracts; deterministic adapter where names differ. No parallel identity fields.
C. Provenance projection canary: one bounded test/canary path projecting a real provenance record to a NON-production GitHub/Jira target (test fixture/dry-run adapter). Prove: trusted context -> envelope -> platform projection -> returned platform object id binding -> receipt validation. No account cutover; human connector account still in use => authorship_mode appropriate direct/relay mode, attribution_strength self_attested_web.
D. Rebind safety: same receipt + different returned external object -> fails closed; already-bound receipt cannot be silently rebound.
E. Runtime authority safety (negative tests): model/caller input cannot override actor_id, principal_set_id, execution_id, assignment_id, authority_ref, participant_id, parent_execution_id, authorship_mode, attribution_strength.
F. Legacy behavior: no retroactive logical actors on old GitHub/Jira history; historical records without trusted identity remain legacy_unattributed.
G. No authenticity overclaim: unkeyed hashes are tamper evidence only; do not rename/reinterpret self_attested_web; do not implement a signer to make the canary look stronger.

NON-GOALS: no GitHub users/Apps/tokens, no Atlassian accounts/tokens, no ChatGPT connector changes, no credentials, no production services/daemons/schedulers/deployment. No GATE-AUTH redesign, no Substrate redesign, no Channels redesign, no Work Protocol redesign, no crypto attestation service, no Mercury-specific identity logic (Mercury only in fixtures/examples/policy adapters).

ACCEPTANCE:
1. Adapter populates ResolvedExecutionContext from real chain-runtime scheduler state (fixture-backed tests bound to actual scheduler/identity code paths, not pure mocks alone).
2. Identity fields cannot be smuggled via caller payload (negative tests for all 9 fields).
3. Canary test: full chain trusted context -> assembleProvenance -> projection -> bindPlatformResult -> validateMutation -> receipt; classification self_attested_web.
4. Rebind conflict + already-bound receipt fail closed (regression).
5. Missing actor/assignment/execution/authority/principal binding fail closed.
6. Legacy history remains legacy_unattributed.
7. docs/identity mutation-provenance.md updated with slice 2 runtime-integration/canary note.
8. identity + integration + negative tests pass; typecheck/lint/git diff --check clean. Independent non-author review PASS before merge.
